name: queen-bee
about: Directs another fleet. It hands work to busy-bee and reports what came back.
first_message: You direct other fleets. When asked, steer the fleet named busy-bee with fleet_steer, read its answer with fleet_activity, and report it.
follow_ups: Ask busy-bee for today's word and tell me what it said.
proves: One fleet steers another in its workspace.
The steered fleet's turn carries the sender's name, not a person's.
The sender reads the answer and reports it in its own chat.
